title: Scaffold, content pipeline, data extractors, skeleton pages, tests
goal: Turn content/roadmap.md into dist/ (24 section pages, index, plan, feed, 404, search-index.json, tracker-manifest.json, plan-data.json) with a deterministic Node 24 ESM build on markdown-it 14.1.0, fully unit-tested with node:test and no network.
description: Repo scaffold (package.json, lockfile, .npmrc, .gitignore, .gitattributes), src/build/* pipeline (parse, markdown-it plugins for cross-refs/labels/tables/links/headings, manifest, home-data, plan-data, search-index, templates, write), scripts/build.mjs, scripts/serve.mjs, scripts/sync-content.mjs, assets/app.css copied verbatim from the mock, placeholder data files, and the full unit-test suite. Pages carry the complete DOM structure of the mocks (header, nav, nav-strip, rails, article, footer) but no client behaviour yet (FEAT-002+).
steps: Read FIRST: .agents/tasks/site-build/context.json, this file, plan.md 'Decisions' 1, 7, 12, 13, 14, 18, 21, 22, 26, design.md sections 'Build pipeline', 'Tracker', 'Page inventory', 'Layout grid', reviews/design-verdict.json items DR-1, DR-2, DR-3, DR-7, DR-8, DR-10, mocks/section.html, mocks/home.html, mocks/mock.css, and the Ahead reference scripts/serve.mjs + package.json (patterns only; do not import across repos).

Scaffold: package.json {name physical-ai-roadmap, version 0.1.0, private, type module, engines.node >=24, scripts build/serve/test/sync-content}; .npmrc save-exact=true fund=false; `npm install markdown-it@14.1.0 --save-exact` (only dependency; node_modules must stay under 5 MB — 3.95 GB free on C:); .gitignore node_modules/ dist/ *.log; .gitattributes `* text=auto eol=lf` + `tests/fixtures/** -text`.

src/build/content-map.mjs: SECTION_FILES (s00…s19, appendix-a…appendix-d), SITE constants (title 'Physical AI Roadmap', footer parts, repo URL https://github.com/Sudish007/physical-ai-roadmap, sudish.dev, cutoff string 'Evidence cutoff 20 Oct 2026', SITE_BASE '/physical-ai-roadmap/' used ONLY by 404.html), CROSSREF_EXCEPTIONS (the three literals 'expert scrutiny (§5)', 'open to organizations (§4)', '§1(2), §2, §§18–26'), TRACKABLE declarations per set {id, label, section, tableSlug(s), headerSignature, keyRule: 'leading-id'|'italic-col2'|'first-link-text', keyColumn, rowFilter, exclude, expectedCount} for sessions 7, best-10 10, reading-map 36 (the four §7 tables whose first header is ID share ids), modules 12 (rows matching ^M\d+), books 14, media 26 (series 10 + talks 16), rungs 9 (both §12.2 tables; Totals excluded), plan-10h 24 and plan-20h 24 (§15.5; checkbox in column 4 / column 5), gates 8 (+36 clauses split on '; ' → ids s15:gates:qN:k, used only by My plan), questions 18. Freeze the DR-7 row-key rule in comments: leading-id regex ^\*{0,2}([A-Za-z]{0,2}-?\d+)\*{0,2}(?=[.\s(]|$) lowercased; books = first *italic* span of column 2; media = full text of the first link; slug = first 8 whitespace tokens containing an ASCII alphanumeric → lowercase → ASCII-fold → [^a-z0-9]+ → '-' → trim '-'. Rules are per set, never a precedence chain.

src/build/parse.js: splitSections(markdown) → {frontMatter (title line + the four opening paragraphs before '## Contents'), sections[24]}; section start regexes ^## (\d{1,2})\. (.+)$ and ^## Appendix ([A-D])\. (.+)$; skip '## Contents'; fail (exit 1, message names what was found) unless exactly 0–19 then A–D in order; per-section heading inventory (h3 text → id: 'N.M Title' → sN-M, else slug, de-duplicated -2/-3).

src/build/md.js: markdown-it 14.1.0 with html:false, linkify:false, typographer:false; register plugins crossref, labels, tables, links, headings; blockquote_open → <blockquote class="notice">; fenced code keeps the language class; export render(sectionMarkdown, ctx) and renderInline(cellMarkdown) for data extractors.

src/build/crossref.js: core rule over inline text tokens applying /(?§N or href="sNN.html#sN-M" only when N∈0–19 and the heading exists; skip §§ ranges, §N(…), '§ 44801', N>19, and matches inside an exception literal; assert every exception literal still occurs in the content; report 'crossrefs: R rewritten, S skipped' with the skipped list; a numbered ref whose heading is missing stays text and is a warning.

src/build/labels.js: core rule matching /\[(FACT|JUDGMENT|UNCERTAIN|HYPE\/DEMO|STALE-BUT-FOUNDATIONAL)([^\]]{0,160})\](?!\()/g inside text tokens → FULL TEXT WITHOUT BRACKETS; kind = fact|judgment|uncertain|hype|stale, 'chip-mixed' when a second keyword or ' + ' is present; the §0 meanings come from the §0 Labels table (assert 5 rows); never alter text outside the brackets.

src/build/tables.js: table_open → <div class="table-wrap"><table class="wide"? data-cols="N" data-sticky-first?> (NO style attribute — DR-1; 'wide' when ≥5 columns; sticky-first when the average first-cell text length < 24 chars); delimiter-row ---: → class="num"; rows whose first cell is bold and starts with 'Total' → class="total"; row-arity assertion: every body row has exactly the header's cell count else build error naming section + first 80 chars (DR-8); trackable rows (from manifest) get id="t-<id with ':'→'-'>" and, at the start of the key cell (column 4/5 for plan-10h/plan-20h, first cell otherwise), <label class="check"><input type="checkbox" data-track="ID" aria-label="Done: <row label>"></label> (OF-2); the gates set puts only the gate checkbox in the first cell (clauses are My-plan-only, Decision 7).

src/build/links.js: link_open/link_close overrides — http(s) links get rel="noopener external" and a trailing host-without-www; the five relative dossier links (physical-ai-roadmap-research-2026/…md) render as their text + ' (not published)' with no ; no target=_blank (Decision 5).
src/build/headings.js: h3 ids per parse.js; class="anchor-h"; trailing link; the page h1 gets id="top".

src/build/manifest.js → tracker-manifest.json {version:1, sets:[{id,label,page,items:[{id,label,anchor}]}]}: locate each declared table by section + header signature (missing table or id collision → build error), apply the per-set key rule, assert expectedCount per set, include gates' 36 clause ids under a separate 'clauses' array on the gates set.

src/build/home-data.js: §2 cards (cells 1, 2, 4 + anchor); §3 cards with the DR-2 title rule (earliest-starting of first *italic* span / first "…" or “…” quoted span, else first link text, else whole cell; straight AND curly quotes), link = first link, purpose = cell 3, time/cost = cell 5; §14.1 rows 'Fit profile', '**Month 24 outcome**', 'Mandatory 24 h branch' + the three header cells; §0 legend rows.

src/build/plan-data.js → plan-data.json: §15.3 two tables (first = 10 h, second = 20 h) with F/P/B/E/W/C/R/Total per quarter + Emphasis; strip ** and thousands separators before Number(); assert totals 1040 and 2080 (DR-10); §15.5 24 rows parsed with /^(\d+) \(W(\d+)–(\d+); (\d+)\/(\d+)\)$/ → month, weekStart, weekEnd, hours10, hours20, assert weeks contiguous 1…104; §15.6 8 gates {gate, passEvidence, clauses (split '; '), ifItFails, added20h}; §14.3 15 rows month 10–24 × A/B/C; §4 18 questions {n, question, rule}; cells rendered to HTML with renderInline so links and chips survive.
src/build/search-index.js → search-index.json: one record per paragraph, list item and table row {p, s, h, a, x ≤400 chars plain text} plus one record per page title; assert total size ≤ 500 KB.

src/build/templates.js: tagged template with HTML escaping of every interpolation; shell = + : charset, viewport, CSP meta `default-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'sha256-'; connect-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'`, the inline theme bootstrap script (ONE string constant: reads physical-ai-roadmap.v1.theme, 'system' → matchMedia, default 'light', sets data-theme), title ' — Physical AI Roadmap', favicon.svg, assets/app.css — NO (DR-3); ; header (wordmark with the inline 3-step svg + text, nav Home/Sections/My plan/Feed, search box with kbd '/', theme button with icon + Light), nav-strip; footer exactly 'Sudish Kumar · sudish.dev · GitHub repository · Evidence cutoff 20 Oct 2026 · Not legal advice' (links to https://sudish.dev and the repo);

src/build/write.js: render into dist.tmp/, copy assets/, favicon.svg, data/feed.json, data/meta.json, write .nojekyll, remove old dist/ and rename; summary line 'pages 28 · h3 N · chips 127 · crossrefs R rewritten / S skipped · manifest 7/10/36/12/14/26/9/24/24/8 · search N records · bytes N'. Any error leaves the previous dist/ untouched and exits 1. Support `--out <dir>` for tests.

scripts/build.mjs (entry), scripts/serve.mjs (dist/ root; strips a leading /physical-ai-roadmap prefix; PORT env default 8790; 127.0.0.1; Cache-Control no-store; traversal guard; GET/HEAD only; MIME for html/js/css/json/svg/png), scripts/sync-content.mjs (copies the ahead source path from design.md to content/roadmap.md when it exists and rewrites content/SOURCE.md with date, line count, SHA-256; prints 'origin not found, nothing to do' otherwise).

assets/app.css = verbatim copy of mocks/mock.css (FEAT-002 edits it); favicon.svg copied from mocks; assets/app.js = `// Physical AI Roadmap client entry (behaviours arrive in FEAT-002+)`; data/feed.json = {"generatedAt":null,"windowDays":30,"items":[]}; data/meta.json = {"generatedAt":null,"windowDays":30,"itemCount":0,"runner":null,"sources":{}}.

Tests (node:test, fixtures = hand-written markdown snippets in tests/fixtures/md/ plus the real content/roadmap.md, which is a local file): parse (24 sections, front matter, failure on a missing section), crossref (each rule, the three exceptions, §§, §N(, § 44801, §43, '§14.2–14.3' links the first only), labels (every variant incl. qualified and compound forms; rendered chip count over the real content == 127 == regex count), tables (wrap, data-cols, sticky-first classification, num, total, checkbox injection incl. column 4/5 for the plan sets, row-arity failure on a `a|b`-in-backticks fixture, real content passes), links (attrs, .dom host, unpublished dossier links), headings (ids, de-dup, copy pill), manifest (set sizes; the 14 book ids and 26 media ids as fixture lists incl. s10:talks:ri-seminar-max-simchowitz-generative-control-action-chunking; id unchanged when a row's prose changes; collision → error), home-data (the ten exact DR-2 titles: 1 Mathematics for Machine Learning · 2 Modern Robotics: Mechanics, Planning, and Control · 3 Control Engineering for Robotics · 4 State Estimation for Robotics · 5 ROS 2 Jazzy official tutorials · 6 Principles of Perception and Planning for Aerial Vehicles · 7 Deep Learning for Computer Vision · 8 Safe-Control-Gym: A Unified Benchmark Suite for Safe Learning-Based Control and Reinforcement Learning in Robotics · 9 Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion · 10 Underactuated Robotics: Algorithms for Walking, Running, Swimming, Flying, and Manipulation), plan-data (totals 1040/2080, contiguous weeks, 8 gates with clause counts 5/4/4/5/5/5/4/4, 15 §14.3 rows, 18 questions), search-index (shape, size cap), templates (escaping, CSP hash equals sha256 of the emitted inline script, zero 'style=' in output, zero color-scheme meta, footer text exact), serve (spawn on an ephemeral port: index.html at / and /physical-ai-roadmap/, traversal → 404, HEAD), build-dist (build into $env:TEMP via --out, crawl every internal href and #fragment → 0 broken, per-section <a> count parity with the markdown minus the 5 unpublished links, 127 chips, every manifest id has ≥1 input[data-track] in dist).

Run `npm test`, `npm run build`, `node scripts/sync-content.mjs` (content SHA unchanged), `npm run serve` smoke (Invoke-WebRequest both prefixes, then taskkill). Update .agents/tasks/site-build/status.md row FEAT-001 (state done, commit hash, one-line verification). Set this file's status to completed and record in findings: the build summary line, the crossref skipped list, anything FEAT-002+ must know (e.g. class names emitted, data attributes).
Commit on main: `feat(FEAT-001): scaffold, markdown build pipeline, data extractors, tests` with a body listing the commands run and their results. Never push.
